0022600190.text: The Nets are 1-6 through seven games and head into their ninth of the season on a one-game losing streak, with a 1-3 road record, 15th in the East, and 5th in the Atlantic, 5.5 games back. The Hawks are 4-4 and on a one-game winning streak, with a 1-2 home record, 7th in the East, and 2nd in the Southeast, 0.5 games back. Brooklyn is without Egor Demin (leg bruise), while Atlanta is missing Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), and the two teams have not met yet in 2026-27 after the Nets lost all four games to Atlanta in 2025-26, most recently 141-107 in Brooklyn in April 2026.
